texts.firmware.agb_boot_bin: Game Boy Advance boot ROM (Game Boy Color mode)
texts.firmware.agb_boot_bin.about: The Game Boy Advance's boot ROM for Game Boy Color games (AGB), 2,304 bytes. It is Nintendo's and you have to supply it.
texts.firmware.cgb_boot_bin.about: The Game Boy Color's boot ROM (CGB), 2,304 bytes. It is Nintendo's and you have to supply it.
texts.firmware.dmg_boot_bin.about: The Game Boy's boot ROM (DMG), 256 bytes. It is Nintendo's and you have to supply it.
texts.firmware.sgb2_boot_bin.about: The Super Game Boy 2's boot ROM, 256 bytes. It is Nintendo's and you have to supply it.
texts.setting.bootrom.about: 'on' starts the console with its own start-up program, the boot ROM, which shows the logo before the game starts; you have to supply it for the console you chose. 'off' starts the game at once, in the state the boot ROM would have left the console in, as Gambatte works it out. The game then starts sooner and some timings differ from a real console. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.linkmodel1.about: Which console the Game Boy of P1 is, in a Game Boy Link machine: GB, GBC or GBA, as for Model. The New Project window chooses the Game Boy Color when the game is a .gbc file. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.linkmodel2.about: Which console the Game Boy of P2 is, in a Game Boy Link machine: GB, GBC or GBA, as for Model. The New Project window chooses the Game Boy Color when the game is a .gbc file. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

texts.setting.linkmodel4.about: Which console the Game Boy of P4 is, in a Game Boy Link machine: GB, GBC or GBA, as for Model. The New Project window chooses the Game Boy Color when the game is a .gbc file. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.model.about: Which console the game runs on: GB the original Game Boy, GBC the Game Boy Color, GBA a Game Boy Advance running a Game Boy Color game (a few games add things on it), and SGB2 the Super Game Boy 2 on a Super Nintendo, which puts the game's border around the picture, takes up to four controllers and adds the SNES's sound. A Game Boy game also runs on the Game Boy Color, which colours it. LINK2, LINK3 and LINK4 are two, three or four Game Boys joined by link cables, each with its own game, as for trading and battling in Pokemon. It is chosen with the machine in the New Project window, and is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.slot.game.help: The Game Boy or Game Boy Color game: the cartridge's contents, a .gb or .gbc file (.sgb for a Super Game Boy one). In a Game Boy Link machine, the game of P1's Game Boy.
texts.slot.game2.help: The game of P2's Game Boy in a Game Boy Link machine: a .gb or .gbc file. It may be the same game as another Game Boy's.
texts.slot.game3.help: The game of P3's Game Boy in a Game Boy Link machine: a .gb or .gbc file. It may be the same game as another Game Boy's.
texts.slot.game4.help: The game of P4's Game Boy in a Game Boy Link machine: a .gb or .gbc file. It may be the same game as another Game Boy's.
texts.slot.savedata.help: The cartridge's battery-backed memory at the start, for a project that begins from a saved game: a file as Emulator > Export Save Data... writes it, or a .sav file of Gambatte's or of another emulator. A cartridge with a clock keeps the clock's registers after the memory, as Gambatte writes them; a file without them starts the clock at zero. In a Game Boy Link machine, P1's. The file is never changed. Leave this empty to start with the cartridge's memory empty.
texts.slot.savedata2.help: The battery-backed memory of P2's cartridge at the start, in a Game Boy Link machine, as for P1's saved data: a file Export Save Data writes ("P2 <game>.sav") or a .sav file of Gambatte's or another emulator's. The file is never changed. Leave this empty to start with the cartridge's memory empty.

texts.suggest.link_models: For a Game Boy Link machine, each Game Boy is the Game Boy Color when its game is a .gbc file, and the Game Boy otherwise.
